name: Secret-Keeper
description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.

abilities.name: Seize Your Moment
abilities.description: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

abilities.name: Our Master’s Will
abilities.description: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Summoning Ritual
abilities.description: Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

abilities.name: Fallen Hounds
abilities.description: Once per scene, when the Secret- Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.
